_about: Closed vocabularies used by the engine. Semantics live in data/rules, not in code (plan v5 §0.1-2).

technique_kinds.prep: preparatory; outside the scenario action window
technique_kinds.entry: crosses into the spacecraft over a graph edge
technique_kinds.ground: acts on mission ground infrastructure the attacker occupies
technique_kinds.onboard: runs on the spacecraft; needs an on-board foothold

command_authority.meaning: command authority and acceptance by the spacecraft

f1_over_isl.meaning: F1 between DU and CU over an inter-satellite link

ng_over_feeder.meaning: Ng between RAN and core over the feeder link

paper_boundaries._source: ASIANComNet 2026 manuscript §III-D and Table I (five trust boundaries)
paper_boundaries.TB2: Ground <-> Space (feeder link, TT&C command path)

MAP-CG-01.text: T1 crosswalk: ENISA threat -> workbook Threat-based controls -> SafeMode 2026.09.23-1 enisa_control edges -> SPARTA technique

MAP-CG-02.text: Attacker-class seeds: techniques whose access position matches the SI attacker class but that T1 does not reach

MAP-CG-03.text: Legacy chain: techniques in the superseded Phalanx TR52 mapping (regression only)

MAP-CG-04.text: Deprecation successors: the non-deprecated v4.0.1 Impact techniques (IMP-0007..IMP-0014), added because every v3.x IMP-0001..0006 is [DEPRECATED] and T1 reaches none of the successors

MAP-CG-05.text: SV claims: SPARTA techniques that SPARTA v4.0.1 relates (related-to) to an SV-* threat statement the ET claims; deprecated techniques dropped; a claimed SV related to a deprecated IMP-* passes its claim to the MAP-CG-04 successors
